profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Hieu Van Nguyen
Email: hieumum@gmail.com
Experience: 15 years
Education: Master of Science in Computer Science

PROFILE
I am a highly passionate software expert, focusing primarily on Web Applications, Web Services, Cloud Computing (used Azure at Microsoft and OCI at Oracle, AWS at Amazon, and GCP for my Personal projects), Big Data (COSMOS and SCOPE), and Mobile Development. My 15 years of professional experience, on top of my undergraduate and graduate studies (in Vietnam and in the U.S.) have equipped me with a profound knowledge of object-oriented design and development, debugging and troubleshooting product issues. My strongest technical skills are C# and .Net Framework, Java, Multi-tier applications, developing and testing websites (ASP.NET, HTML5, CSS3, jQuery, JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, Silverlight, IIS, MVC, MVVM, Ajax, Kendo UI, Knockout, React, Firebug, Fiddler, Selenium), MS SQL Server, COSMOS, and SCOPE. I have experience in many platforms including Windows 8.1/10, Windows Server 2008/2012, Windows Mobile 6.1/6.5, Blackberry, and Linux. I'm also proficient in using tools like WTT, MS Test, ProductStudio, CoreXT, MS Build, Jira, Git, Jenkins. In addition, I possess strong analytical, problem solving, and communication skills; a passion for solving puzzles, algorithms, and developing on a rock-solid foundation; and am able to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment either independently or in a team.

ACHIEVEMENTS
Honors & Awards
1. Excellence In Innovation Award for eBayHere local marketplace project (12/2018)
2. Innovation Rotation Award for eBayHere local marketplace project (12/2018)
3. First Prize for eBay Flash Sale hackathon project (09/2019)
4. Third Prize in Algebra at national mathematical Olympiad (05/2003)
5. Third Prize in Calculus at national mathematical Olympiad (05/2003)

Patent
1. Crowdsourcing Locations For Seller Privacy (IP-P3430US1) 

Publication
1. A Hybrid Approach of Noun Phrase Translation in Cross-Language Information Retrieval (Springer 2007)

MY CERTIFICATES (Frontend, Backend, AI from Google, Meta)
https://hieu-van-nguyen.github.io/certificates/

MY BLOG
https://www.dailycodingpractices.com/ 

MY PORTFOLIO
https://hieu-van-nguyen.github.io/portfolio/

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Senior Software Engineer at Walmart Global Tech

positions.title: Senior FullStack Software Engineer
positions.description:
I work as a primary dev for the new features and also migrate old pages in the legacy app to the new app.
Lead the development of new Web Apps
- Drive the design for the new feature and improvements 
- Use Claude Code and Apple own plugins and LLM models to assist with coding
- Work with PM to clarify the requirements
- Create One-pager, design docs and review them with the team to get sign-off 
- Develop new UI using React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS
- Develop new Web service using Java and SpringBoot framework
- Develop Stored Procedure using Oracle SQL
- Develop Unit tests for both UI and Service to meet the minimum team’s coverage requirements (80%)
- Investigate and fix bugs
- Building data pipelines with Kafka
- Support QA team in testing the features
Technical Environment:
- IntelliJ, SpringBoot, Java, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Sql Developer,  Oracle DB, Oracle SQL Developer, Claude Code, Ollama

positions.title: SDE 3
positions.description:
I work as a SDE 3 (consultant) for the Device Tracker team. I own the Device-Tracker V1 portal while the Amazon team (FTE) is working on Device-Tracker V2 portal. I also contribute to V2 when I have capacity

- Develop new features and fix bugs for Device-Tracker V1
- Develop new features for Device-Tracker V2
- Develop Quick Sight Report
- Fix ETL scripts
- Own the features E2E
- Work with PM to clarify the requirements
- Create One-pager, design docs and review them with the team to get sign-off 
- Develop new UI using React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap
- Develop new Micro services using Java and Scala
- Develop Unit tests for both UI and Service to meet the minimum team’s coverage requirements (80%)
- Investigate and fix bugs

Technical Environment:
IntelliJ, Java, Scala, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Bootstrap, Postgres, Dynamo DB, Lambda, EC2, S3, API Gateway, Dagger

positions.title: Senior Member Of Technical Staff
positions.description:
I am a senior MTS at the Identity Access Management team (IAM). IAM is the tier 0 service of OCI that does authentication, SSO, profile and policy management. My main responsibilities are:
•	Drive the design for the new features and improvements (e.g. new microservices for my team to break the monolith system, Design a solution to get sev2 Alarm every time a component is down)
•	Investigate security reports from security central and artifact scanning , I either need to fix the security reports by updating code, maven dependencies, config update, or filed SDRs to explain why this is not a problem
•	Keep The Lights On (On-call, Deployment, Bug fixes, Customer support)
•	Develop and test Web Services using Java and Spring framework
•	Develop and test Web UI using Node.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, HTML, CSS
•	Develop test automation using Python, Selenium
•	Do Code Review,  Dev Design review
Technical Environment:
IntelliJ, Oracle DB, Spring, Java, Python, Selenium, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Git, JIRA, Jenkins

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
I am a Full-Stack developer in the eBay Core Shipping team. Our team focus on creating the best seller experience. The goal is to make shipping and logistic a great experience for both sellers and buyers. My main responsibilities are to develop new application (web application and mobile application), tools and services for our sellers to list items and set preferences. In addition, I am a member of the newly formed eBay Front-End community, we want to create and share the modern and standard UI across all eBay products.
•	Own products E2E (get requirements, design, develop, test, deploy, maintenance)
•	Daily Triage/Scrum meeting
•	Troubleshooting, debugging live site issues and provide hot fixes
•	Investigate the root causes of the issues in order to make a long-term fix
•	Code review, Dev Design review
•	Develop and test Web UI using Node.js, JavaScript, jQuery, React, Marko, HTML, CSS
•	Develop and test Web Services using Java and Spring framework

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
As a software engineer II at Microsoft Data Insights team, my main responsibilities are to develop and test the data warehouse, data pipeline, Web APIs, automation tools, and a web portal for data visualization (Business Insights, Customer Insights, Engineer Insights, and Key Performance Indicators). I’m also working on a machine learning project. 
•	Daily Triage/Scrum meeting
•	Troubleshooting, debugging live site issues and provide hot fixes
•	Investigate the root causes of the issues in order to make a long-term fix 
•	Code review, Dev Design review
•	Develop and test new feature for the web portal using C#, MVC, MVVM, jQuery, TypeScript, Knockout, AngularJS, Kendo UI, AJAX, HTML, CSS, Firebug, Fiddler
•	Develop and test the Web services using ASP.NET Web APIs
•	Develop and test Data warehouse and Data pipeline using MS SQL Server 2012/2014
•	Develop and test Modern Data warehouse using COSMOS, SCOPE
•	Develop and test automation tools in order to monitor pipelines (latency check, data validation, anomaly detection)
Technical Environment:
•	Windows Server 2008/2012 R2, Visual Studio 2012/2013 Ultimate, SQL Server 2012/2014, COSMOS, SCOPE, MVC 4, MVVM, Firebug, Fiddler, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, TypeScript, Knockout, Kendo, Profiler tools, SSAS,  TFS, Code Flow Review

positions.title: SDE 2
positions.description:
MICROSOFT COMMERCE PLATFORM

Microsoft Commerce Platform is the platform for Microsoft partners to register their products and services on the market place so that customers can search for, download and buy them. My main responsibilities are to:
•	Daily Triage/Scrum meeting
•	Troubleshooting, debugging live site issues and provide hot fixes
•	Investigate the root causes of the issues in order to make a long-term fix 
•	Code review, Dev Design review
•	Design, and Develop new features (MVC web site, WCF services, Syndication Feed, SEO improvement)
o	UI (HTML, CSS, Firebug)
o	Service Layer (SOAP, REST)
o	Back-End (MS SQL Server)
•	Technical Environment:
•	Windows Server 2008 R2, VS 2010, SQL Server 2008 R2, MVC 3, Firebug, JavaScript, jQuery, Profiler tools, SSIS, Product Studio, CoreXT, Source Depot, Code Flow Review

MICROSOFT FOREFRONT IDENTITY MANAGER - FIM (8/2011 - 3/2012) Redmond, Washington, USA - SDET 3
FIM offers users a comprehensive solution for managing identities, credentials, and identity-based access policies across heterogeneous environments. Responsibilities:
•	Develop and update Common Library for the UI testing framework, they are used to test the Forefront portal, password registration & reset portal.
•	Develop and update the configurable TestDriver, they are used to drive functional testing and performance testing
•	Do Functional testing and investigate the failures
•	Do Performance and Load testing, analyze performance data to figure out which aspects need to be improved.
•	Do Fuzz testing, SQL injection, JSON injection, cross site scripting.
Technical Environment:
•	Windows Server 2008, Visual Studio Team System 2008 Team Suite, SQL Server 2008, Profiler tools, Product Studio, WTT, CoreXT, Source Depot.
